observation.visible_scene: Against a solid blue backdrop, a sculpted sand/rock mound on the left holds two parallel inclined metal-rod tracks that run to the right over a sandy surface. The upper track is a pair of rods that stays empty. The lower track is a rod channel carrying rolling balls: two pink balls sit in a chute carved into the top of the mound, and two blue balls are already further down the lower track to the right. A static 'AMAKANDU' watermark sits in the top-left corner.
visible_changes: The two pink balls roll downward along the rock chute and onto the lower rod track, advancing toward the right.
The two blue balls roll downhill along the lower rod track, staying ahead (to the right) of the pink balls; the left-to-right ordering pink-pink-blue-blue is preserved across the excerpt.
The upper rod track remains empty for the whole segment.
The viewpoint pans/tracks rightward along the structure: the rock mound gradually slides out of frame on the left and more of the sandy ground and the far end of the track enter view on the right.

Because of the camera pan, individual balls' positions within the frame shift non-monotonically (e.g. a ball can appear to move right then left in-frame) even as it continues moving rightward in the scene.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the balls were released or started moving (motion is already underway at the first frame).
What happens beyond the right end of the track and whether balls leave the scene (the last frame is an arbitrary cut, not a completion).
The full length/layout of the track system and any structures outside the cropped view.
uncertain_details: Exact speeds or acceleration of each ball, since frame positions are confounded by camera motion.
Whether the leading blue ball temporarily exits the right edge and re-enters, or whether additional blue balls are present.
Material identities of the balls, rods, and mound (not verifiable from the images).
